title: Upper Canada Campground

services.name: Trailer Rentals
services.desc: We have three identical Jayco trailers available to rent. The trailers are permanently set up on sites 122, 123, and 124. They are fully equipped with dishes, cutlery, pots, pans, toaster, Keurig (two pods included), fridge, stove, microwave, air conditioner, furnace, flat top griddle, picnic table, and a fire ring. The bathroom consists of a sink, toilet and shower. You must bring your own bedding, toiletries, and towels. There is a three night minimum for our trailer rentals in July and August and a two night minimum in May, June and September with a three night minimum on long weekends.
